headline: Accountant Md. Mostakur Rahman appointed Governor of Bangladesh Bank
summary: He replaces Ahsan H. Mansur in the role of the country's central bank chief.
details: The government has appointed Md. Mostakur Rahman as the new Governor of Bangladesh Bank.
Md. Mostakur Rahman is an accountant by profession.
He takes over the position from Ahsan H. Mansur, who has been removed from the post.

headline_marked: Man injured as [[two crude bombs explode in Mirpur]]
headline: Man injured as two crude bombs explode in Mirpur
summary: The explosions occurred outside a courier service office at Challantika intersection; police suspect a business dispute.
details: One person was injured after two crude bombs exploded outside the AJR Parcel and Courier Service office at the Challantika intersection in Dhaka's Mirpur-11 on Tuesday evening.
The explosions took place around 8:30 PM, according to Pallabi Police chief Jalal Uddin. A courier service worker was hurt and was subsequently taken to a hospital by local residents.
CCTV footage revealed that two individuals on a motorcycle arrived at the scene, threw two crude bombs in quick succession, and then fled the area.
Police suspect the attack may have been motivated by a business dispute, noting that a similar explosion had previously occurred outside the courier service's head office.
In a separate incident, another crude bomb exploded outside the Bangladesh Television building in Rampura earlier on Tuesday, though no injuries were reported in that case.
Police from both Pallabi and Rampura stations are currently investigating the incidents and working to identify the suspects involved.
caption:
Two crude bombs exploded in Mirpur, leaving one worker injured. CCTV shows suspects on a motorcycle fleeing the scene.

One person was injured after two crude bombs exploded outside the AJR Parcel and Courier Service office at the Challantika intersection in Dhaka's Mirpur-11 on Tuesday evening.

The explosions took place around 8:30 PM, according to Pallabi Police chief Jalal Uddin. A courier service worker was hurt and was subsequently taken to a hospital by local residents.

CCTV footage revealed that two individuals on a motorcycle arrived at the scene, threw two crude bombs in quick succession, and then fled the area.

Police suspect the attack may have been motivated by a business dispute, noting that a similar explosion had previously occurred outside the courier service's head office.

In a separate incident, another crude bomb exploded outside the Bangladesh Television building in Rampura earlier on Tuesday, though no injuries were reported in that case.

Police from both Pallabi and Rampura stations are currently investigating the incidents and working to identify the suspects involved.
